script_writer.job: write the bilingual script and scene list from one story outline
script_writer.check: schema: scene count, words per scene, both languages present; banned-word lint

story_checker.job: assess the script against the source outline and the audience rules, and list every problem
story_checker.check: schema: verdict is pass or fail with a reason per rule; independent re-read of the outline

producer.job: render narration, illustrations and the assembled video from a passed script
producer.check: exit code 0; ffprobe schema: duration in range, audio track and both subtitle tracks present

packager.job: write the title, description, tags and thumbnail brief for a passed script
packager.check: schema: title length, description credits the source tale, audience flag set

publish.job: upload the video as private, then make it public on the approved date
publish.check: exit code 0 and the platform returns the video id with the expected privacy status
